Served river-to-table, it's simply cooked for a soft and flaky flesh with a mild flavor.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Roasted Trouts are a type of [[Roasted Food]], and they can be made by exposing [[Chillfin Trout]]s, [[Sizzlefin Trout]]s, [[Voltfin Trout]], or [[Stealthfin Trout]]s to a [[Fire]] or [[Scorching Climate]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} [[Blue Hinox]]es also have a chance to drop Roasted Trouts when killed by [[Link]]. Their flesh is soft, flaky, and has a mild flavor. When eaten, Roasted Trouts restore one and a half [[Heart]]s to Link. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Roasted Trouts reappear in {{TotK}} and are again a variety of [[Roasted Food]]. They can be made by exposing [[Chillfin Trout]]s, [[Sizzlefin Trout]]s, [[Voltfin Trout]], or [[Stealthfin Trout]]s to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. Their flesh is soft, flaky, and has a mild flavor. When eaten, Roasted Trouts restore one and a half [[Heart]]s to Link. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Frozen Trout * Roasted Food * Trout }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Roasted Food, Seafood |items= BotW, TotK }}
